services.desc: Redfield Estate is an award-winning wedding and events venue located inside The Grove Nature Preserve, a 150+ acre National Historic Landmark. Rentals include the entire estate, featuring a vintage craftsman style home complete with dressing rooms and fireplace. Seasonally filled urns and fountains lend accent, along with a 30’ x 60’ covered-stone Pavilion (with fireplace), period lighting, a rustic gazebo tucked into the forest, a large meadow and pond. This stunning estate is ideal for weddings, retreats, business meetings, milestones, celebrations of life, and holiday gatherings. Capacity is 2-125, depending on the event date and season.
